questions.prompt: Do `user.name` and `user.email` log you in to GitHub?
options: Yes, they are your GitHub credentials
No: GitHub authenticates you only during remote operations such as `git push`
questions.explanation: They are commit metadata. GitHub authenticates you when you connect for remote operations, with HTTPS (username/password or token) or an SSH key.

questions.prompt: Which command does the note use to generate an SSH key?
questions.explanation: `ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "you@example.com"`; the RSA 4096 form is the alternative for older systems. The `.pub` key is then added under GitHub → Settings → SSH and GPG keys.

questions.prompt: Git opened `git log` in the pager. Which key quits?
questions.explanation: `q` quits the pager; `b` goes back a page, `d` moves to the next section, `f` and Space move forward a page.
